edges.reason: onlyManager requires msg.sender == manager before setting the withdrawal fee
msg.sender is compared against the manager storage variable for privilege checks
setManager is protected by onlyOwner evaluated against msg.sender
setFeeRecipient is protected by onlyOwner evaluated against msg.sender
initialize sets ownership using _msgSender derived from msg.sender
block.timestamp is used to compute nextOptionReadyAt with the delay
rollToNextOption requires block.timestamp >= nextOptionReadyAt
_closeShort requires block.timestamp > otoken.expiryTimestamp()
withdrawETH performs a low-level ETH transfer to msg.sender
ETH sent to msg.sender enables a callback back into the vault
withdraw delegates to _withdraw to burn shares and transfer fees
_burn reduces the share balance of msg.sender
_mint credits newly minted shares to msg.sender
deposit pulls asset tokens from msg.sender
depositETH wraps msg.value and mints shares for the caller
sellOptions invokes the external SWAP_CONTRACT.swap with a manager-supplied order
_closeShort triggers adapter.delegateCloseShort delegatecall
emergencyWithdrawFromShort triggers adapter.delegateCloseShort delegatecall
rollToNextOption triggers adapter.delegateCreateShort delegatecall
shortAmount = wmul(currentBalance, lockedRatio) depends on fixed-point arithmetic
feeAmount = wmul(withdrawAmount, instantWithdrawalFee) fixed-point arithmetic
commitAndClose sets the next option terms
commitAndClose closes the existing short position
total = lockedAmount.add(currentAssetBalance) feeds share conversion math
_setNextOption queries the adapter for the option address
deposit calls _deposit to mint shares
depositETH calls _deposit after wrapping ETH
closeShort calls _closeShort to unwind the position
constructor resolves and stores the adapter from the factory
